description: WP-G5 — player-controlled RAPID REACTIONS (Aquilan Shield, 1 CP). Fixture cus11e_c5_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE, P2 Custodes, round 2). Setup privileges as cus11e_rapid_reactions.
